COLORS, MIXING & CREATIVITY WORKSHEETS

Colors, Mixing & Creativity worksheets — free printables for age 4.

Coloring, mixing, sorting and design — print the studio activities and color them for real. Every sheet twins with a real game in Colors, Mixing & Creativity (Class 26) — download the PDF, print from the page, or play online.

Chameleon’s Color Magic Age 4Class 26Colors A chameleon waiting for its colors: pick from your key and paint each part — it changes color either way.
